mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months indicates severe labor market deterioration, triggering corporate cost-cutting and reduced consumer spending that drives negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal collapsing real estate demand, reducing household wealth and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% MoM for three months) indicates robust manufacturing expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) during INDPRO growth exceeding 1.5% MoM for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly increases in industrial production (INDPRO) consistently reflect expanding manufacturing output, immediately boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent price pressures that compel Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of 20-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: Post-recession recovery phase, defined by sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising housing starts (HOUST), accelerates consumer and business spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive months of positive MoM GDPC1 and HOUST growth.
